record_title: Hermite–Hellmann–Feynman extrapolation for constrained eigenvalue penalties
provenance: Analytic consequences of the constrained-eigenvalue penalty path and Hellmann–Feynman sensitivity developed in arXiv:2609.18538, combined with classical Hermite interpolation and simple symmetric-eigenvalue perturbation theory.
limitations: The theorem assumes a simple constrained eigenvalue and sufficiently large positive penalty in the non-finitely-exact regime. It is an asymptotic scalar extrapolation, not a certified bound; multiple eigenvalues, finite-eigensolve error amplification, backward stability, and end-to-end computational complexity are not resolved. The coefficient-blind optimality statement is restricted to linear extrapolators for analytic inverse-power expansions. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; specialized older structural-penalty asymptotics and contemporaneous follow-up remain residual risks.
